note.label: The Colossians & The CHRISTIANS of America

precepts.why:
John is told, “What thou seest, write in a book, and send it unto the seven churches which are in Asia”, and the first of them is Ephesus. Paul writes to Timothy, “And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus.”

That same Tychicus was sent to Colosse. In Colossians 4, “All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you, who is a beloved brother, and a faithful minister and fellowservant in the Lord: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that he might know your estate, and comfort your hearts”, together “With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you.”

Ephesus is right there next to Colosse. The same messengers served that whole region, going between the churches of Asia. So the Colossians were not off by themselves: they were part of that same body of churches in Asia that Christ sent his word to in Revelation.

So when John was told to send what he saw “unto the seven churches which are in Asia”, it was the same region and the same people the epistle to the Colossians was written to.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 1 A Visit From The Lord

“When those went, these went; and when those stood, these stood; and when those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.” So the spirit of the angels was in the chariot. note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 1 A Visit From The Lord

In every government there is a top guy: that is the Lord, he is going to be the top, and under him there is going to be the 12, then the rest of the 144 under that. note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 1 A Visit From The Lord

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 1 A Visit From The Lord

He is Alpha and Omega, which is Greek for the beginning and the ending. “When he prepared the heavens, I was there:” You see that, heavens with an S? “when he set a compass upon the face of the depth: When he established the clouds above: when he strengthened the fountains of the deep: When he gave to the sea his decree, that the waters should not pass his commandment: when he appointed the foundations of the earth: Then I was by him, as one brought up with him:” That is why it says he is the only begotten Son. He was the first of the creation, then I was by him as one brought up with him, meaning the Father taught Christ everything. Before Michael was created, Christ was created; before Uriel and Gabriel and Raphael and all the rest, Christ was made before every last one of them. That is why John said about Christ, he was preferred before me.

“and I was daily his delight, rejoicing always before him; Rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth; and my delights were with the sons of men.” My delights were with the sons of men.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 1 A Visit From The Lord

precepts.why: “Even the mystery which hath been hid from ages and from generations, but now is made manifest to his saints:” The Israelites. “To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you,” So the mystery of the glory, which is Christ in you, had to be taught to the northern kingdom. “that he might be a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make reconciliation for the sins of the people.” How could he be a faithful high priest for us if he didn't go through what we went through, if he wasn't born like we were born? note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 1 A Visit From The Lord

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 1 A Visit From The Lord

precepts.why:

“piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit,” That is why when we teach brothers, when we teach sisters, we must use the words of God, the words in the Bible. “and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.” That is why when you make judgments, use the scriptures. Bring out the laws of God; that is going to cut people.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 1 A Visit From The Lord

precepts.why:
He has the keys of hell and of death. “And I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.” People read that and get confused; John 20:23 explains exactly what it means.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 1 A Visit From The Lord

They received him as an angel of God.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 1 A Visit From The Lord

precepts.why: “Know ye not that we shall judge angels?” You read that and say oh, we are going to be telling Michael and Gabriel what to do. Listen: you ain't telling Michael, Gabriel, Uriel, Raphael, none of them archangels, nothing to do. Matthew 19:28 shows what it is talking about: judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 1 A Visit From The Lord

precepts.why: This explains what it means by judging angels. “And Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.” See that: judging the twelve tribes of Israel. precepts.why: “And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgment was given unto them:” What type of judgment? Power to make judgments over who? The twelve tribes of Israel. That is the judging of angels in 1 Corinthians 6:3.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 1 A Visit From The Lord

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 1 A Visit From The Lord

precepts.why: The term angels is a reference to men on earth as well; when you read it, read it in context. “And Achish answered and said to David, I know that thou art good in my sight, as an angel of God:” As an angel of God.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 1 A Visit From The Lord

precepts.why:
This is another verse that trips brothers up; some of you just skip it. “For this cause ought the woman to have power on her head because of the angels.” Who has a number next to the word power in their Bible? Because of the angels: because of her husband, and the leadership, and the men, because the angels is going into men. What if she doesn't have a husband, what if her father died? This is why Rebekah covered herself when she saw Isaac. She asked the servant, who is this young man? He said, that is my master Isaac, and she covered her head. She had already left her father, miles away, and she wasn't married yet, but she covered her head. Why? Because of the angels, and the angels are a reference to men on earth.
